pieces.title: Who gets called
pieces.caption: Every page's avatar, sized by how many other pages link to it. Ten pages take a fifth of all the links. Eighteen are never called at all. *What is real and what is a choice:* Links between pages, map build of 2026-11-09. Whether this is the 'expert collapse' the page warns of is a reading, not a count. *Leaking in:* The whole palace, with Weave Ceremony's hubs up front.

verdicts.why: The counts are right but "never called at all" (caption and in-image line) is false as worded: the eighteen have no typed link from another map page, and the list includes Return Ceremony and The Palace Voice, which CHILD.md calls every session; Palace Map itself says "what everyone holds, no one needs to cite". Change both lines to "eighteen have no typed link pointing at them". The mosaic itself is good and the title can stay.
